import numpy as np
from statsmodels.nonparametric.linbin import fast_linbin

# Test case 3: 200 random samples to show count preservation
rs = np.random.RandomState(12345)
data = rs.standard_normal(200)
x = data
result = fast_linbin(data, x.min(), x.max(), 512)
probe('random_counts_sum', float(result.sum()))
probe('random_nobs', float(len(data)))

probe('random_moment_preserved', float(moment))
probe('random_data_mean', float(np.mean(data)))
